page: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-16 is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on Intel Xeon processors operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 24 MB L3 cache pool. Hardware-assisted compute instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES and bit manipulation extensions such as BMI2 and ADX.

The server is paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local storage is not bundled with this configuration, requiring attached persistent disk options for primary file systems and data storage. Network configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and no dedicated GPU hardware is included on the machine.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid memory subsystem efficiency, achieving a strong tier PassMark memory score of 2,768.04. Memory throughput testing demonstrates 92.33 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 48.24 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes. General compute evaluations reveal middle-tier performance, marked by a multi-core stress-ng rating of 16,636.04 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 8,129.0. In application-level benchmarks, the instance delivers 14,171.0 points in Clang compilation tasks and handles 15.61 million Redis SET operations per second, though large-model language processing yields lower throughput without hardware accelerators.

With its dedicated high-frequency cores and robust memory bandwidth, Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-16 serves compute-intensive workloads that require dependable core performance without GPU acceleration. Primary deployment scenarios encompass distributed compilation, high-concurrency web serving, gaming servers, mid-scale data processing pipelines, and in-memory caches.
description: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-16 is a compute-optimized virtual server configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon processors with 8 physical cores, it supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES cryptography. The system does not include local disk storage or bundled GPUs, relying instead on network-attached persistent storage. Benchmark results show strong memory subsystem throughput, attaining a top-quartile PassMark memory score alongside 92.33 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. General processor benchmarks place it consistently in the middle tier, with a multi-core Geekbench score of 8,129.0 and 15.61 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. The absence of local solid-state drives requires consideration for storage-intensive tasks, but the high per-core clock speed makes this configuration well aligned with continuous integration pipelines, software compilation, scientific computation, and memory-backed web application serving.
